
=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.WWP_UpdateNotificationDefinitions ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&MailTemplatePath = !"C:\Program Files (x86)\GeneXus\GeneXus18\Packages\Patterns\WorkWithPlus\Resources\MailNotificationTemplate.html"

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

Do 'Update Notification Definitions'
Do 'Import Mail Template'

Commit


Sub 'Update Notification Definitions'

  	&WWP_NotificationDefinitionCollection = WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.WWP_AutomaticNotificationDefinitionsToLoad()
	For &WWP_NotificationDefinition In &WWP_NotificationDefinitionCollection
		&WWPNotificationDefinitionId = WWP_GetNotificationDefinitionByName(&WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionName, &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPEntityId)
		If &WWPNotificationDefinitionId > 0
			Msg(format(!'Updating Notification %1...', &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionName), status)
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.Load(&WWPNotificationDefinitionId)
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.WWPNotificationDefinitionAllowUserSubscription = &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionAllowUserSubscription
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.WWPNotificationDefinitionAppliesTo = &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionAppliesTo
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.WWPNotificationDefinitionDescription = &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionDescription
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.WWPBaseObjects.WWPNotificationDefinitionIcon = &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionIcon
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.WWPNotificationDefinitionLink = &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionLink
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.WWPNotificationDefinitionLongDescription = &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionLongDescription
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.WWPNotificationDefinitionShortDescription = &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionShortDescription
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.WWPNotificationDefinitionTitle = &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionTitle
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.WWPNotificationDefinitionSecFuncionality = &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPNotificationDefinitionSecFuncionality
			&WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.Save()
			If &WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.Fail()
				Msg(!"Error: " + &WWP_NotificationDefinitionToUpdate.GetMessages().ToJson(), status)
			EndIf
		Else
		Msg(format(!'Creating Notification %1...', &WWP_NotificationDefinition.WWPBaseObjects.WWPNotificationDefinitionName), status)
			&WWP_NotificationDefinition.Save()
			If &WWP_NotificationDefinition.Fail()
				Msg(!"Error: " + &WWP_NotificationDefinition.GetMessages().ToJson(), status)
			EndIf
		EndIf
	EndFor

EndSub

Sub 'Import Mail Template'

	&MailTemplate.Load(!"MailNotification")
	If &MailTemplate.Fail()
		Msg(!'Importing Mail template...', status)
		&TemplateFile.Source = &MailTemplatePath
		
		&MailTemplate = new()
		&MailTemplate.WWPMailTemplateName = !"MailNotification"
		&MailTemplate.WWPMailTemplateDescription = !"Template for sending notifications"
			
		WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetParameter.Text(!"Sender_Name", &SenderName)
		&MailTemplate.WWPMailTemplateSenderName = &SenderName
		
		WWP_GetParameter.Text(!"Sender_Address", &SenderAddress)
		&MailTemplate.WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress = &SenderAddress
    
		&MailTemplate.WWPMailTemplateSubject = !"New notification"
		&MailTemplate.WWPMailTemplateBody = &TemplateFile.ReadAllText()
		&MailTemplate.Save()	
	EndIf

EndSub


=== Transaction: WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplate ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	&TrnContext.FromXml(&WebSession.Get(!"TrnContext"))
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- After Trn (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	AuditTransaction.Call(&AuditingObject,&pgmname)	
   [web]
   {
	
	If (&Mode = GeneXus.TrnMode.Delete and not &TrnContext.CallerOnDelete)
		WWP_MailTemplateWW.Call()
	Endif
	Return
   }
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
[web]
{
parm(in:&Mode, in:&WWPMailTemplateName);

WWPMailTemplateName = &WWPMailTemplateName if not &WWPMailTemplateName.IsEmpty();
noaccept(WWPMailTemplateName) if not &WWPMailTemplateName.IsEmpty();
noprompt(WWPMailTemplateName);

}

LoadAuditWWP_MailTemplate.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, WWPMailTemplateName, &Mode) on beforeUpdate;
LoadAuditWWP_MailTemplate.Call(!'Y', &AuditingObject, WWPMailTemplateName, &Mode) on beforeDelete;
LoadAuditWWP_MailTemplate.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, WWPMailTemplateName, &Mode) If Insert on BeforeComplete;
LoadAuditWWP_MailTemplate.Call(!'N', &AuditingObject, WWPMailTemplateName, &Mode) If Update on BeforeComplete;
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.Notifications.Common.WWP_GetNotificationDefinitionByName ===

--- Source (Source) ---
&WWPNotificationDefinitionId = 0
For Each WWP_NotificationDefinition
	Where WWPNotificationDefinitionName = &WWPNotificationDefinitionName
	Where WWPEntityId = &WWPEntityId
	&WWPNotificationDefinitionId = WWPNotificationDefinitionId
	Exit
EndFor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
Parm(in:&WWPNotificationDefinitionName, in:&WWPEntityId, out:&WWPNotificationDefinitionId);

=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetParameter ===

Stub Text(in:&ParameterName, inout:&TextParameter)
	Do Case
		
		//SMPT Parameters (Sample SMTP Parameters for a GMAIL email account)
		Case &ParameterName = !"SMTP_Host"
			&TextParameter = !"smtp.ionos.mx" 
		Case &ParameterName = !"SMTP_Username"
			&TextParameter = !"contact@erphi-cone.com" //Your GMAIL account
		Case &ParameterName = !"SMTP_Password"
			&TextParameter = !"wMV13ZBrkU@" //Your GMAIL account password
			
		//SMS Parameters (From Sinch Account)
		Case &ParameterName = !"SMS_ServicePlanId"
			&TextParameter = !'9361a7469c1344ee8f4c957e36226d93'
		Case &ParameterName = !"SMS_Token"
			&TextParameter = !'fcd01c5592574e2d9b07248b2a6b9ab4'
		Case &ParameterName = !"SMS_ApplicationKey"
			&TextParameter = !"dddddddd-dddd-dddd-dddd-dddddddddddd"
		Case &ParameterName = !"SMS_ApplicationSecret"
			&TextParameter = !"dddddddddddddddddddddd=="
		Case &ParameterName = !"SMS_DefaultSender"
			&TextParameter = !'+447537455299'

		//Mail Sender Parameters
		Case &ParameterName = !"Sender_Name"
			&TextParameter = !"Hi-Cone" 
		Case &ParameterName = !"Sender_Address"
			&TextParameter = !"contact@erphi-cone.com" //Your GMAIL account
      
		//Notification Parameters
		Case &ParameterName = !"Notification_BaseURL"
			//This should be replaced with your fixed BaseURL if you will send Notifications by an scheduled process 
			&TextParameter = &HTTPRequest.BaseUrl 
	EndCase
EndStub

=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.Mail.LoadAuditWWP_MailTemplate ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

If &SaveOldValues = !'Y'
	If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Delete or &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
		Do 'LoadOldValues'
	EndIf
Else
	Do 'LoadNewValues'
EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'LoadOldValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplate
		Where WWPMailTemplateName = &WWPMailTemplateName
		&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
		&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

		&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'WWP_MailTemplate'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Mode = &ActualMode
		&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateName'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Name'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = WWPMailTemplateName.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateDescription'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Description'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = WWPMailTemplateDescription.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateSubject'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Subject'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = WWPMailTemplateSubject.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateBody'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Body'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = WWPMailTemplateBody.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Sender Address'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderName'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Sender Name'
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
		&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.OldValue = WWPMailTemplateSenderName.ToString()
		&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadNewValues'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For Each WWP_MailTemplate
		Where WWPMailTemplateName = &WWPMailTemplateName
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Insert

			&AuditingObject = new AuditingObject()
			&AuditingObject.Mode = &ActualMode

			&AuditingObjectRecordItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.TableName = !'WWP_MailTemplate'
			&AuditingObject.Record.Add( &AuditingObjectRecordItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateName'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Name'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateName.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateDescription'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Description'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = True
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateDescription.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateSubject'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Subject'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateSubject.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateBody'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Body'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateBody.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Sender Address'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem = new AuditingObject.RecordItem.AttributeItem()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderName'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Description = 'Sender Name'
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsPartOfKey = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.IsDescriptionAttribute = False
			&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPBaseObjects.WWPMailTemplateSenderName.ToString()
			&AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute.Add(&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem)

		EndIf
		If &ActualMode = TrnMode.Update
			For &AuditingObjectRecordItem in &AuditingObject.Record
					For &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem in &AuditingObjectRecordItem.Attribute
						Do Case
							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateName'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateName.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateDescription'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateDescription.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateSubject'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateSubject.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateBody'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateBody.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.ToString()

							Case &AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.Name = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderName'
								&AuditingObjectRecordItemAttributeItem.NewValue = WWPMailTemplateSenderName.ToString()

						EndCase
					EndFor
			EndFor
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPBaseObjects.LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	WorkWithLink.Link = WWP_MailTemplateWW.Link()
	For each WWP_MailTemplate
		where WWPMailTemplateName = &WWPMailTemplateName
		Form.Caption = WWPMailTemplateDescription.ToString()
		&Exists = True
	When none
		Form.Caption = "WWP_RecordNotFound"
		&Exists = False
	Endfor
	If (&Exists)
		Do 'LoadTabs'
	Endif
	&RecordDescription = Form.Caption
	If &Session.Get(!'DiscussionThreadIdToOpen') <> ''
		ddc_Discussions.Open()
	EndIf
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	If Not WWP_HasDiscussionMessages(!'WWP_MailTemplate', WWPMailTemplateName)
		ddc_Discussions.Icon = "far fa-comment"
	EndIf
	If (WWP_HasSubscriptionsToDisplay(!'WWP_MailTemplate', WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.SpecificRecord))
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = True
	Else
		ddc_Subscriptions.Visible = False
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

=== WebPanel: WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWW ===

--- Start (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = Page.Rows
	Grid_Empowerer.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	If &HTTPRequest.Method = HttpMethod.Get
		Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndIf
	ddo_AGExport.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnAGExport.InternalName
	&AGExportData = new()
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'Export'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	&AGExportDataItem = new()
	&AGExportDataItem.Title = ''
	&AGExportDataItem.Icon = ActionExportReport.Link()
	&AGExportDataItem.EventKey = !'ExportReport'
	&AGExportDataItem.IsDivider = False
	&AGExportData.Add(&AGExportDataItem)
	
	DDC_Subscriptions.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnSubscriptions.InternalName
	
	&IsAuthorized_WWPMailTemplateDescription = WWPBaseObjects.SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'wwp_mailtemplateview_Execute')
	
	&GAMSession = GAMSession.Get(&GAMErrors)
	DDO_Grid.GridInternalName = Grid.InternalName
	DDO_Grid.GAMOAuthToken = &GAMSession.Token
	Form.Caption = ' Mail Template'
	Do 'PrepareTransaction'
	Do 'LoadGridState'
	If &OrderedBy < 1
		&OrderedBy = 1
		Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
	EndIf
	&DDO_TitleSettingsIcons = GetWWPTitleSettingsIcons()
	DDO_GridColumnsSelector.TitleControlIdToReplace = BtnEditColumns.InternalName
	GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue = Grid.Rows
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Refresh (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)
	Do 'CheckSecurityForActions'
	Do Case
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 1
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
		Case &ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 0
			Do 'LoadSavedFilters'
	EndCase
	Do 'SaveGridState'
	
	If &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf
	WWPMailTemplateName.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(1).IsVisible
	WWPMailTemplateDescription.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(2).IsVisible
	WWPMailTemplateSubject.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(3).IsVisible
	WWPMailTemplateBody.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(4).IsVisible
	WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(5).IsVisible
	WWPMailTemplateSenderName.Visible = &ColumnsSelector.Columns.Item(6).IsVisible
	&GridCurrentPage = Grid.CurrentPage
	&GridPageCount = Grid.PageCount
	&GridAppliedFilters = WWP_GetAppliedFiltersDescription(&Pgmname)
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangePage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Previous'
			Grid.PreviousPage()
		Case GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage = !'Next'
			Grid.NextPage()
		Otherwise
			&PageToGo.FromString(GridPaginationBar.SelectedPage)
			Grid.GotoPage(&PageToGo)
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- GridPaginationBar.ChangeRowsPerPage (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Grid.Rows = GridPaginationBar.RowsPerPageSelectedValue
	Grid.FirstPage()
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_Grid.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderASC#>' OR DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>'
			&OrderedBy.FromString(DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get)
			&OrderedDsc = iif(DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#OrderDSC#>', true, false)
			Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus'
			Grid.FirstPage()
		Case DDO_Grid.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Filter#>'
			Do Case
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'WWPMailTemplateName'
					&TFWWPMailTemplateName = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'WWPMailTemplateDescription'
					&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'WWPMailTemplateSubject'
					&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress'
					&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
				Case DDO_Grid.SelectedColumn = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderName'
					&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName = DDO_Grid.FilteredText_get
					&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel = DDO_Grid.SelectedValue_get
			EndCase
			Grid.FirstPage()
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Grid.Load (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&Update = !'<i class="fa fa-pen"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Update)
		&Update.Link = WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplate.Link(TrnMode.Update, WWPMailTemplateName)
	Endif
	&Delete = !'<i class="fa fa-times"></i>'
	If (&IsAuthorized_Delete)
		&Delete.Link = WWP_MailTemplate.Link(GeneXus.TrnMode.Delete, WWPMailTemplateName)
	Endif
	If (&IsAuthorized_WWPMailTemplateDescription)
		WWPMailTemplateDescription.Link = WWP_MailTemplateView.Link(WWPMailTemplateName, '')
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDO_GridColumnsSelector.OnColumnsChanged (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	&ColumnsSelectorXML = DDO_GridColumnsSelector.ColumnsSelectorValues
	&ColumnsSelector.FromJson(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	SaveColumnsSelectorState(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWColumnsSelector', iif(&ColumnsSelectorXML.IsEmpty(), '', &ColumnsSelector.ToXml()))
	Refresh
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_ManageFilters.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Clean#>'
			Do 'CleanFilters'
			Grid.FirstPage()
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Save#>'
			Do 'SaveGridState'
			WWPBaseObjects.SaveFilterAs.Popup(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWFilters', &PgmName + !"GridState")
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Case ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey = !'<#Manage#>'
			ManageFilters.Popup(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWFilters')
			&ManageFiltersExecutionStep = 2
			Refresh
		Otherwise
			&ManageFiltersXml = GetFilterByName(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWFilters', ddo_ManageFilters.ActiveEventKey)
			If &ManageFiltersXml.IsEmpty()
				msg('WWP_FilterNotExist')
			Else
				Do 'CleanFilters'
				SaveGridState.Call(&PgmName + !"GridState",  &ManageFiltersXml)
				&GridState.FromXml(&ManageFiltersXml)
				&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
				&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc
				Do 'SetDDOSortedStatus' 
				Do 'LoadRegFiltersState'
				Grid.FirstPage()
				Refresh
			EndIf
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- 'DoInsert' (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	If (&IsAuthorized_Insert)
		WWP_MailTemplate.Call(GeneXus.TrnMode.Insert, nullvalue(WWPMailTemplateName))
	Else
		msg("WWP_ActionNoLongerAvailable")
		Refresh
	Endif
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- ddo_AGExport.OnOptionClicked (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	Do Case
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'Export'
			Do 'DoExport'
		Case ddo_AGExport.ActiveEventKey = !'ExportReport'
			Do 'DoExportReport'
	EndCase
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- DDC_Subscriptions.OnLoadComponent (Event) ---
/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */
	WWPAux_WC.Object = WWP_SubscriptionsPanel.Create(!'WWP_MailTemplate', Notifications.WWP_NotificationAppliesTo.AnyRecord, '', '')
	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

--- Rules (Rules) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.WWP_GetEntityByName ===

--- Source (Source) ---
For Each WWP_Entity
	Where WWPEntityName = &WWPEntityName
	&WWPEntityId = WWPEntityId
	Exit
When None
	&WWP_Entity = New()
	&WWP_Entity.DB.WWPEntityName = &WWPEntityName
	&WWP_Entity.Save()
	If &WWP_Entity.Success()
		&WWPEntityId = &WWP_Entity.WWPEntityId
	EndIf
EndFor

--- Rules (Rules) ---
Parm(in:&WWPEntityName, out:&WWPEntityId);


=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWExport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1
&FirstColumn = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"WWP_MailTemplateWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Name")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateName.IsEmpty())
			WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Name")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateName)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Description")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Description")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Subject")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Subject")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sender Address")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel, 1, 1000))
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sender Address")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, 1, 1000))
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sender Name")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel, 1, 1000))
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sender Name")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName, 1, 1000))
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each WWP_MailTemplate
		order WWPMailTemplateDescription  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateDescription)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateName  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateName)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateSubject  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateSubject)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateSenderName  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateSenderName)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using WWP_MailTemplateWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFWWPMailTemplateName, &TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject
					, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateName'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(WWPMailTemplateName)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateDescription'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(WWPMailTemplateDescription)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateSubject'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(WWPMailTemplateSubject)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateBody'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(WWPMailTemplateBody, 1, 1000))
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, 1, 1000))
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderName'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWPBaseObjects.WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(WWPMailTemplateSenderName, 1, 1000))
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ExcelDocument.Save()
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'CheckStatus'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)
		&Filename = ""
		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateName", '', !'Name', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateDescription", '', !'Description', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateSubject", '', !'Subject', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateBody", '', !'Body', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress", '', !'Sender Address', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateSenderName", '', !'Sender Name', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

EndSub

Sub 'LoadGridState'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	// Load grid state from session.
	If &Session.Get(!"WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWGridState") = !""
		&GridState.FromXml(WWPBaseObjects.LoadGridState.Udp(!"WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWGridState"))
	Else
		&GridState.FromXml(&Session.Get(!"WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWGridState"))
	Endif	

	&OrderedBy = &GridState.OrderedBy
	&OrderedDsc = &GridState.OrderedDsc

	For &GridStateFilterValue in &GridState.FilterValues
		Do Case
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"FILTERFULLTEXT"
				&FilterFullText.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATENAME"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATENAME_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATEDESCRIPTION"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATEDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESUBJECT"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESUBJECT_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERADDRESS"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERADDRESS_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERNAME"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERNAME_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWExportReport ===

--- Source (Source) ---

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to a PDF file.
&IsAuthorized = SecGAMIsAuthByFunctionalityKey.Udp(!'wwp_mailtemplateww_Execute') 
If &IsAuthorized

	LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'

&Title = "Mail Template List"

//Report Template Source
	Header
		&AppName = "DVelop Software Solutions"
		&Phone = !"+1 550 8923"
		&Mail = !"info@mail.com"
		&Website = !"http://www.web.com"
		&AddressLine1 = !"French Boulevard 2859"
		&AddressLine2 = !"Downtown"
		&AddressLine3 = !"Paris, France"
		Print printTitle
	End 
	Footer
		&PageInfo = "Page: " + &Page.ToString().Trim()
		&DateInfo = "Date: " + &Today.ToFormattedString()
		Print printFooter
	End

	Do 'PrintFilters'

	Do 'PrintColumnTitles'

	Do 'PrintData'

	Do 'PrintFooter'

EndIf

Sub 'PrintFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not &FilterFullText.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockFilterFilterFullText
	EndIf
	If not &TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFWWPMailTemplateName.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateName
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateDescription
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateSubject
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel.IsEmpty()
		print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel
	Else
		If not &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName.IsEmpty()
			print printBlockTFWWPMailTemplateSenderName
		EndIf
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	print printBlockLines_titles

Sub 'PrintData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each WWP_MailTemplate
		order WWPMailTemplateDescription  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateDescription)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateName  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (DB.WWPMailTemplateName)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateSubject  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateSubject)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateSenderName  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateSenderName)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using WWP_MailTemplateWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFWWPMailTemplateName, &TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject
					, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel)

		Do 'BeforePrintLine'
		print printBlockLines_data
		Do 'AfterPrintLine'
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

=== Procedure: WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWGetFilterData ===

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

&Options = new()
&OptionsDesc = new()
&OptionIndexes = new()
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'LoadGridState'
Do Case
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_WWPMAILTEMPLATENAME'
		Do 'LoadWWPMailTemplateNameOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_WWPMAILTEMPLATEDESCRIPTION'
		Do 'LoadWWPMailTemplateDescriptionOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_WWPMAILTEMPLATESUBJECT'
		Do 'LoadWWPMailTemplateSubjectOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_WWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERADDRESS'
		Do 'LoadWWPMailTemplateSenderAddressOptions'
	Case &DDOName.ToUpper() = !'DDO_WWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERNAME'
		Do 'LoadWWPMailTemplateSenderNameOptions'
EndCase

&OptionsJson = &Options.ToJson()
&OptionsDescJson = &OptionsDesc.ToJson()
&OptionIndexesJson = &OptionIndexes.ToJson()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

	Else

				&TFWWPMailTemplateName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)

Sub 'LoadWWPMailTemplateNameOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFWWPMailTemplateName = &SearchTxt
	&TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each WWP_MailTemplate
		Order WWPMailTemplateName
		using WWP_MailTemplateWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFWWPMailTemplateName, &TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject
					, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel)

		Option Distinct
		If not WWPMailTemplateName.IsEmpty()
			&Option = WWPMailTemplateName
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'LoadWWPMailTemplateDescriptionOptions'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription = &SearchTxt
	&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel.SetEmpty()
	For Each WWP_MailTemplate
		Order WWPMailTemplateDescription
		using WWP_MailTemplateWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFWWPMailTemplateName, &TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject
					, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel)

		&count = 0
		For Each WWP_MailTemplate
			Order WWPMailTemplateDescription
			&count += 1
		EndFor
		If not WWPMailTemplateDescription.IsEmpty()
			&Option = WWPMailTemplateDescription
			
			&Options.Add(&Option)
			&OptionIndexes.Add(trim(&count.ToFormattedString()))
		EndIf
		If &Options.Count = 50
			Exit
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

		&count = 0

			Order WWPMailTemplateSubject

		EndFor
